title: Overview: Lightning Safety — National Weather Service
claims: There is no safe place outside when thunderstorms are in the area; if you hear thunder you are likely within striking distance of the storm.
Substantial buildings and hard-topped vehicles are safe options; rain shelters, small sheds and open vehicles are not safe.
Monitor weather conditions and get to a safe place before the weather becomes threatening; cancel or postpone activities early if thunderstorms are expected.
Wait 30 minutes after the last lightning or thunder before going back outside; many people go outside too soon after the storm has seemingly passed.
Lightning victims do not carry an electrical charge and are safe to touch; call emergency services, monitor the victim, and start CPR or use an AED if needed.
